en.title: Missed a Timed Entry in China: Legitimate Same-Day Recovery
en.headline: Missed Your Timed Entry in China? What the Gate Rules Actually Say
en.description: Two recovery paths for an expired slot, the nine-field rule card, three official venue patterns with no-show strike ladders - and why no national grace period exists.
en.heroAlt: The Meridian Gate of the Forbidden City seen from below: red wall, gate arch and painted eaves under a clear sky.

zh.heroAlt: 仰视故宫午门：红色宫墙、门洞与彩绘屋檐映衬晴空。
